Inventory complete. Committed as `30d05ca` at `docs/app-inventory-20260407.md`.

**Summary of findings:**

- **22 protected routes, 6 public routes** — all functional, no broken pages
- **~280 backend endpoints** across 39 route files — all wired up (3-4 stubs: content generation, route optimization, directions)
- **49 DB migrations, 9 cron jobs, 12 external API integrations** — all active
- **5 new features since yesterday:** days-in-stage dashboard cards, calendar storm search, insurance claim fields, stale lead alerts, content studio grid
- **14 of 15 originally "Missing" features** from the competitor matrix have been built
- **4 truly missing vs competitors:** QuickBooks sync, SMS/Twilio, native mobile app, AI phone answering

**Top 3 improvement priorities:**
1. QuickBooks sync (every competitor has it)
2. SMS/Twilio integration (UI exists, needs backend)
3. Multi-page estimate structure (quality gap vs SumoQuote)
